region: How to paste the text into your agent

scenes.title: Copy the text
scenes.caption: In Leafen, “Copy text” copies a text with a one-time code for connecting.

scenes.title: Paste it into your agent
scenes.caption: You paste it into an agent such as Claude Code or Codex and press Enter.

scenes.title: Allow it to run
scenes.caption: The agent adds Leafen by itself. When it asks to run a command, you choose “Yes”.

scenes.title: Connected
scenes.caption: When Leafen shows the agent’s name, it’s connected.

mock.agentStart: I’ll connect to Leafen. First, I’ll trade the one-time code for a key.
mock.agentDone: Connected to Leafen. How would you like to start: move your Notion workspace here, or start from an empty workspace?
mock.agentDoneConnected: Connected to Leafen. You can use it in this conversation now.
